data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number, select the suggestion) with the correct service-number parameter, and only adds a "Find my bus" click that may be unnecessary. It is concrete enough to automate, though the "Track my bus" click is only implicit in the first step.
